# Write the report

Create `reports/airway-report.qmd` using a plain-text editor. Start with this template and replace the prompts with your own verified findings:

````markdown
---
title: "Airway case study: report"
format: html
---

# Question

State the comparison and design.

# Data and methods

Give the data source, sample counts, gene-count source, model design, contrast, filtering and software versions from the run log.

# Results

Include the PCA figure, a small table or cited values from the differential-expression output, and a checked sample total. Identify the contrast direction and any missing/NA values.


## Figures

![Library sizes.](../results/airway/figures/library-sizes.png)

[Describe the library sizes using checked numbers and state a limitation.]

![PCA.](../results/airway/figures/sample-pca.png)

[Describe the pca using checked numbers and state a limitation.]

![Sample-distance heatmap.](../results/airway/figures/sample-distances.png)

[Describe the sample-distance heatmap using checked numbers and state a limitation.]

![MA plot.](../results/airway/figures/ma-plot.png)

[Describe the ma plot using checked numbers and state a limitation.]

![Volcano plot.](../results/airway/figures/volcano.png)

[Describe the volcano plot using checked numbers and state a limitation.]

![Selected-gene expression.](../results/airway/figures/selected-gene.png)

[Describe the selected-gene expression using checked numbers and state a limitation.]

# Interpretation and limitations

Separate observed patterns from tested differential expression. Note design constraints, sample size and what this analysis cannot establish.

# Reproduce

Record the exact input preparation, analysis and verification commands.
````

After saving the file, render it from the main project folder:

```bash
quarto render reports/airway-report.qmd --to html
```

Quarto prints the rendered output location; open that HTML file. If results have not been generated, label the report as **pending** rather than inventing figures or counts. Cite the [airway package](https://bioconductor.org/packages/airway/) and original paper if using that case study.

**Final check:** can a reader trace every numerical statement to a generated table, figure or independent check? Does the conclusion match the design and limitations?
